title: Skill is just small part of trading
summary: Having skill and a strategy is not enough. The only real way to grow is to follow that strategy every single day without breaking any rules — that’s what discipline actually means.Risk management is equally important. With discipline, you take position size strictly according to your portfolio. Most big losses happen when you feel extremely confident in a trade and end up oversizing. No matter how confident you are, never oversize a trade.Most people blow their accounts for one reason: oversizing.I can bet that 99% of people cannot take the same setup for 25 consecutive trades. Either they change the setup, increase the stop loss, or exit early by taking profit too soon.All of this comes from a lack of confidence — because you’ve never properly backtested the strategy or taken enough trades using the same setup. That’s why you fall into FOMO.No matter how good of your analysis is ypu wont be a profiyanle trader unless you fix thisI’ve experienced all of this myself.submitted by/u/Atul_Rana[link][comments]
